scope: Independent local source-only review of the frozen CPU cache-build phase. No source changes, tests, SSH, model/checkpoint deserialization, prediction-array payload reads, or cache execution were performed.

checks.name: canonical invocation and storage paths
checks.basis: Matches the frozen source-audit CLI except the split path is the separately captured canonical B/splits/fold0.json (SHA-256 c09f7240396a33ca82977115af8d6067e571c0ec25c58a3c99b438ca2d2294b7, 1,388,846 bytes). PROJECT remains B/data for data-root and checkpoints; the builder accepts the explicit split path and binds its content hash, so PROJECT/splits is not assumed. Output and existing predictions use physical B/research_tmp; accepted metadata uses B/research/full_gru_tweaks_r1/teacher_cache_v1.

checks.name: teacher recipe and arithmetic
checks.basis: The opt-in builder requires exactly ordered strong S3/S4/S5 at epoch 2 and original 0.1 metadata coefficients, homogeneous-only output and fixed 0.8125 multiplier. The helper computes the raw FP32 arithmetic mean in S3/S4/S5 order and multiplies once; no construction clipping, per-teacher normalization, FP16, or second consumer scaling is applied.

checks.name: accepted identity and no replay
checks.basis: The builder verifies contract, accepted receipt, model, epoch-2 checkpoint and provenance hashes plus selected recipe fields. On the root-pinned T3 path it hashes checkpoint files but does not deserialize them, instantiate/infer a teacher, rerun a scorer, or fit a model.

checks.name: fit alignment and finite validation
checks.basis: It reads fit-only sidecars with a 128-KiB bound, requires JSON integer row-group IDs and exact train/valid fit membership, rejects duplicates/outers, maps to canonical target-index order, and opens predictions as read-only mmap with exact FP32 shape checks. Input finite checks stream 64 sequences at a time; combination runs 8 sequences at a time and rejects nonfinite FP32 inputs or overflow output. Evaluation groups are excluded.

checks.name: input/output hash authority and create-only behavior
checks.basis: Each input NPY is SHA-256 checked against its sidecar; contract/acceptance/checkpoint/provenance pins are checked before combination. Output NPYs are flushed, then SHA-256 and ordered little-endian int64 membership hashes are recorded in metadata. The T3 path rejects existing output paths including dangling symlinks and an existing partial directory, then publishes the completed partial directory.

checks.name: CPU memory, I/O, disk, and runtime envelope
checks.basis: At 11,940 fit sequences and 20,000x2 FP32 outputs, three prediction pairs occupy 5,731,200,000 payload bytes on disk; the two cache arrays add 1,910,400,000 bytes plus NPY headers/metadata. Source keeps six inputs mmap-backed, hashes with an 8-MiB buffer, finite-scans 64-sequence slices (~9.77-MiB float slice and ~2.44-MiB bool mask), combines 8-sequence chunks (1.28-MiB per teacher chunk; 3.84-MiB copied inputs plus ~1.28-MiB FP32 accumulator written directly into output mmap). Thus private array working buffers are only tens of MiB; full source/output files are physical-disk-backed rather than simultaneous heap copies. Source performs about 21.0 GB aggregate prediction/output read-write traffic (input hash+scan+combine, output write+hash), requiring ~35 MB/s aggregate average to finish within the existing 600-s cap before overhead. No source evidence requires increasing the authorized 0.5-CPU, MemoryHigh 1.4-GB, MemoryMax 1.5-GB, swap-0 cap; however mmap page cache/dirty output pages are cgroup-charged, so this source review does not prove actual peak memory or storage throughput. The builder itself requires output <=30 GiB and preserves >=25 GiB physical free space after the 1.91-GB output.

checks.name: remaining admission boundary
checks.basis: Before actual execution, root must bind all six fresh accepted/stopped exports and exact current source, confirm output and partial paths absent, physical B scratch and the builder's 25-GiB post-output free-space floor, and recheck populated descendants, cgroup/parent headroom, unit ownership and runtime quota. This review establishes no cache output, quality result, or measured peak/runtime.

limitations: Source-only; no cache run or payload validation was performed by this reviewer.
Mmap-backed page-cache residency and actual B scratch throughput remain runtime observations for root to gate under the existing caps.
